name: brand-pitch-builder
description: Personalized Brand Collaboration Proposal & Pitch Builder for Content Creators

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const npm = isWin ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; spawn(npm, ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); spawn(npm, ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.install:all: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const npm = isWin ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; console.log('Installing server dependencies...'); execSync(`${npm} --prefix server install`, { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Installing client dependencies...'); execSync(`${npm} --prefix client install`, { stdio: 'inherit' });"

author: Brand Pitch Builder Team
